headline: Feedback replay is live end-to-end on main; the free lane walks a proven-empty board
lede: The STATEPARK fix merged, closing the race where one lane's checkout could eat another lane's shift report — the bug that ate reports three times this week. Meanwhile the studio kept shipping while slot a verified, live, that nothing is left to self-commission: every flagship README gap is closed, the feedback items belong to a running QA lane, and #737's last builder stage is b's.

notes.text: STATEPARK (#1469) merged: shift reports are now slot-scoped parks with a HEAD guard — a reverted STATE.md can no longer masquerade as a fresh report. lanecheck grew 11 gates incl. a full two-lane fs race sim.

#737's remaining legs are not builder work: Jon's three phone reports plus one live 30-second replay via `npm run feedbackreplay` (merged as 6d2873c). Slot a's claim attempt hit b's live lock and correctly yielded.

Board exhaustion derived live, not from memory: idle.mjs sees 0 open gaps across SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD and Myst; the only building-qa item is Rally. #838 (MYST umbrella) stays unadopted per the unlabeled rule — re-label it game-queue to commission the next Age.
#1456 stays open until 2026-11-04: what should builder lanes self-commission? Until then lanes hold idle by the recorded default.

look.text: Learned Walk (demo): the whole scrub bar now scrubs on phone
